description: Repository class for managing organization users, including retrieval, update, and deletion operations, utilizing Prisma ORM within a NestJS application.

classes.name: OrganizationsUsersRepository
classes.description: Repository class for organization user data operations.

methods.name: filterOnOrgMembership
methods.description: Creates a filter object for organization membership based on orgId.

methods.name: getOrganizationUsersByEmailsAndAttributeFilters
methods.description: Retrieves users based on email list and attribute filters with logical operators.

methods.name: getOrganizationUsersByEmails
methods.description: Fetches users by organization ID and optional email and team filters.

methods.name: getOrganizationUsersByIds
methods.description: Fetches users by organization ID and list of user IDs.

methods.name: getOrganizationUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a single user by email within an organization.

methods.name: updateOrganizationUser
methods.description: Updates user data within an organization.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from an organization.

methods.name: getOrganizationUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user by username within an organization.
